events.text: A £3.20 service fee is shown beside your foreign-currency cash withdrawal. The transaction and fee are listed in your secure portal.
I don't understand the £3.20 fee shown against this withdrawal. Please escalate this and check which tariff entry applied and how it accounts for the amount.
I am starting the review by matching the recorded transaction type and processing date against the tariff in force on that date. Case HV-034; no refund or account change is authorised by this review.

summary: Mara Ellery, an unverified customer on secure chat, asked the desk to escalate and check which tariff entry applied to a £3.20 fee on a withdrawal and how it accounts for the amount. The desk classified this as a request to record a fact about a fee and passed a question about the £3.20 fee to the documents system, and the case closed in that asked state. A later attempt to send a reply was refused, so no answer has gone to Mara, and the record does not say who handles the response from here.
